# KruxOS Documentation

> Technical documentation for KruxOS — the operating system for AI agents.

Canonical docs site for install guides, API reference, capability catalog, policy model, and operator workflows.

- [Getting Started](https://docs.kruxos.com/getting-started/)

## Ports (per KruxOS instance)

| Port | Service | Auth |
|------|---------|------|
| 7800 | Dashboard (HTTPS) | Operator passphrase |
| 7700 | MCP Gateway (WebSocket) | Agent API key (64-char hex) |
| 7701 | Supervision WebSocket | `krx_user_*` or operator session |
| 7702 | Trigger-wake (UDP) | Loopback only |
| 7703 | User API (HTTP) | `krx_user_*` bearer |

## Quick install (Docker)

```bash
docker run -d --name kruxos --privileged \
  -e KRUXOS_VAULT_PASSPHRASE='choose-a-strong-passphrase' \
  -p 7800:7800 -p 7700:7700 -p 7701:7701 \
  -v kruxos-data:/data/kruxos \
  altvale/kruxos:latest
```

Open https://localhost:7800 — complete the 8-step first-boot wizard.
